prose.text: - **The live round** is the block's `round` and `live` entries, fired by `gate.py run --live-legs --entry N`, one   drive at a time (step 13). The wrap never re-runs it; it re-verifies from `evidence/`. - **Non-priming probe:** `conductor preconditions --for real-model-interpretation` precedes every drive. It fires no   canary. There is no `boot` before any drive: it would prime the incident the drive's own canary dedupes against   (verification-harness.md 2026-08-19 (a)). - **Operator entries before the round** are fired once, by hand, in block order, and their results recorded in the   ledger: the Pulse git probes, the old-side control, the builds, the new-side control, the env checks, the dir   listing. `pulse-app` is launched between them and the round (step 12); the agent starts it and stops it, on the   overseer's grant. - **The binary control is two report-only entries around the builds and one asserting entry after them.** The   asserting entry passes when at least one string of the new sentence is in the rebuilt `pulse-app`; on the   `5f77859` build it prints `sentence-a=0 sentence-b=0` and exits 1 (measured at P4). Which strings the section   names is decided by step 5's rule over the two report-only tables, so no entry has to be edited if one candidate   fails a side. - **Smoke:** `status` is mint-then-read on `d3`'s `run_id`. - **The attempt ledger has no producing entry:** the agent authors it from the entries' recorded results and from   Pulse's own log, as every prior series' ledger was. The criteria that read it are held by the harvest   (`pre_registered` reads its digest line) and by the host-path probe. - **Night rule:** only the three `live` entries are GPU runs. Every other entry runs at any hour. - **Pulse builds and binary probes** run in the Pulse tree inside a subshell `cd`: cargo reads its config from the   cwd, and the session's Bash guard passes a subshell `cd` and blocks a top-level one. - **Host paths:** every Pulse binary probe runs from inside `target/release` with bare file names; the model digest   entry prints the digest alone. Nothing an entry prints names a host path beyond what the gate tool respells. - **Controls owed at implement** (red before green, one-shot): step 14's `measured` table. Its readings go to the   report. - **The operator pass** (hygiene, the pre-CI commit, the guarded push, the CI read) is the operator's. The agent   performs it only on the operator's explicit word, and records it as made on that word.
